_title: decidiq: put motion to the vote
_note: What you see: Put a motion to the vote and record the outcome
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Een motie in stemming brengen en de uitkomst vastleggen
decidiq: motie in stemming brengen: decidiq: put motion to the vote
Wat nu? Breng de motie in stemming: What now? Put the motion to the vote
De stemming over de motie opent voor de: The vote on the motion opens for the council members present. Until the chair closes the vote, nobody can change the motion.
